name: git init
purpose: Initialize a new local Git repository in the current folder.
explanation: Creates a hidden .git folder inside your project directory. This .git folder is Git's memory where all snapshots and history are stored.
whenToUse: Once at the start of a new local project before tracking files with Git.
commonMistakes: Manually editing or deleting the hidden .git folder.
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `git init` in a standard Unix-like shell.
commonErrors: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

beforeAfterState.before: Repository working tree / index / history prior to command.
